newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh, Chinese presidents discuss oil, trade.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh, Chinese presidents discuss oil, trade.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin and Kazakh President Nursultan Nazarbayev met in Beijing on Friday to discuss China's involvement in developing the former Soviet republic's oil riches, Kazakh state television said.

Nazarbayev and Jiang also talked about the possibility of exporting landlocked Kazakhstan's resources through neighbouring China to world markets, the Khabar news programme said. It gave no further details of the talks.
The meeting took place on the second day of official mourning for China's paramount leader, Deng Xiaoping, who died on Wednesday.
The Kazakh government on Friday sent condolences to Chinese Premier Li Peng, saying in a message made available to reporters: "We share the sorrow of the Chinese people."
